summary: Fixes earlier specifications that used underscored DNS node names before a registry existed. Now that RFC 8552 defines the registry, this document updates those specifications so they register and use their names correctly. It is a Best Current Practice.

eli5.summary: Before there was a shared list for special folder names, different groups picked names on their own. This document tidies up the old rules so they match the new list.

questions: which rfcs use underscored dns labels
